name: @deepsea/chat-title
description: DeepSea plugin: a rename_chat tool that lets the agent review the automatic chat title and rename the chat when the title is wrong, generic or stale, in the titler's style, never over a title the person chose; a system-prompt rule and a runtime-context line carrying the current automatic title. Host-only.

scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check title.mjs && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
